model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across 5 datasets, comparing results with and without context. The horizontal axis contains two categories: "With Context" and "Without Context". The vertical axis represents "Average Performance", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60. The chart features two groups of bars: blue bars representing performance with context and purple bars representing performance without context. The blue bars have approximate values of 58 and 59. The purple bars have approximate values ranging from 44 to 48. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any of the bars. The chart does not contain grouped or stacked bars; instead, it presents side-by-side comparisons for each category. A legend provides information on the color coding, indicating that blue and purple correspond to performance with and without context, respectively.
